scene: You climb the stairs into a bustling, sunlit train concourse.
picture: Flat side view along a polished marble station concourse floor. On the far left sits a striped newspaper kiosk. Left of centre, the curly-haired boy in a denim jacket stands gazing forward. Up high hangs an enormous mechanical flip board. On the right, a cherry-red tram rests on brass rails with open doors.
shown: a huge mechanical flip-schedule board ticking rapidly up high
a striped newsagent booth with paper stacks on the left
a cherry-red vintage tram with doors open on the right
